steer.layer: The residual stream it adds to: 0 is the embeddings, l the output of block l − 1; all, a range (3-7) or a list (1,4) work too.
steer.dir: The direction added, by name, used as stored, so its length counts.
steer.scale: How many times the direction is added at every position; 0 changes nothing, below 0 pushes the other way.

project.layer: The residual stream it acts on: 0 is the embeddings, l the output of block l − 1; all, a range (3-7) or a list (1,4) work too.
project.dir: The direction whose part of the stream is taken away or turned round, by name; only its direction counts, not its length.
project.mode: remove takes the part along the direction away; reflect turns it round, so it points the other way.
project.to: zero measures the part from nothing; mean measures it from the stream's corpus mean, so remove sets it to the ordinary amount.
project.k: How many directions go at once: 1 is the direction alone, more adds the next principal directions of what it was made from.

noise.layer: The residual stream it adds noise to: 0 is the embeddings, l the output of block l − 1; all, a range (3-7) or a list (1,4) work too.
noise.sigma: How much noise: a share of each position's own size (its root mean square), so 1 adds about as much as the stream holds; 0 changes nothing.
noise.abs: On, sigma is an absolute amount, the same at every position, rather than a share of the stream's size.
noise.seed: The noise's own seed (the run's if left out): the same seed gives the same noise every pass.

transplant.layer: The residual stream that is replaced: 0 is the embeddings, l the output of block l − 1.
transplant.prompt: The other prompt, run on the unchanged model, whose stream is taken.
transplant.at: Which token of this prompt receives it: −1 is the last, −2 the one before; 0 and up count from the start.
transplant.from: Which token of the other prompt it is taken from: −1 is the last, −2 the one before; 0 and up count from the start.

embed.swap: Two single tokens, a,b: the model reads each with the other's input embedding (GPT-2 tokens usually start with a space).
embed.mix: With a swap, how far the first word's embedding moves toward the second's instead: 0 its own, 1 the second's; the second word is left as it is.
embed.token: One single token that gets a fixed noise vector added to its input embedding, wherever it occurs.
embed.sigma: With token=, the noise's size as a share of the token's embedding: 1 adds about as much as the embedding holds.

vocoder.layer: The one layer of the residual stream where the modulator's band levels are imposed: 0 is the embeddings, l the output of block l − 1.
vocoder.prompt: The modulator: the text whose band levels, measured on the unchanged model, are imposed on the text being written.
vocoder.bands: How many bands of principal directions, spaced logarithmically; rounding merges some of the narrowest, so 16 gives 15.
vocoder.mix: How far each band moves to the modulator's level: 0 changes nothing, 1 imposes it fully.
